name: UniProt
tagline: Universal protein sequence and functional annotation REST API
description: UniProt provides free REST access to the Universal Protein Resource: protein sequences, function annotations, taxonomy, and cross-references across Swiss-Prot and TrEMBL. Developers query by accession, search with Lucene-style syntax, stream bulk downloads, and retrieve JSON or other formats from rest.uniprot.org without API keys for typical use.

auth.details: No API key or account required for public REST access; requests are open over HTTPS. Heavy bulk use should follow published rate guidance and contact UniProt support if needed.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Fully free public academic resource; no paid plans. Practical limits are rate-based (see rate_limits), not a free-tier quota.

rate_limits: Published guidance: about 5 requests/second per IP for interactive use; bulk jobs and streaming preferred for large downloads. Exact hard caps may vary; contact UniProt for sustained high volume.
use_cases: fetch protein sequence and annotations by UniProt accession
search UniProtKB with gene name or organism filters
retrieve cross-references to PDB, Ensembl, or GO for a protein
stream bulk UniProt entries for offline analysis
map protein IDs across databases via UniProt ID mapping
get taxonomy-linked protein sets for a species
